text:
maria (product): Drafting internal release note for the v2.3.0 runtime roll. Staging deploy is green, planning prod change window 03/22 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need pin confirmation for model artifact `redwood-model/v2.3.0-p1` and a final rollback play. Pls ack who owns canary monitoring + docs copy.

maria (product): Draft snippet below — please review quickly: 
```
- Upgrade runtime to 2.3.0: async KV cache optimizations and attention kernel selection fixes
- Model pinned: redwood-model/v2.3.0-p1 (quantized FP16)
- Expected impact: ~8-12% cost reduction on embeddings, latency neutral
- Rollback: automatic fallback to redwood-model/v2.2.9 on canary failure
```

james (relops): I can take the pin and do the deploy schedule. Can we pin to the commit SHA instead of the tag? avoids drift.

kai (backend): staging canary metrics looked fine for the 3 hour run. One thing: watch the KV-migration path — we saw a 100ms spike during long-tail sequences. Recommend canary at 10% for 30m.

miguel (eng-sre): Agree with kai. For rollback: if error_rate > 1% or 95th latency increases by >40% for 5m during canary, we rollback. Owner: miguel will run rollback, james will coordinate deploy.

lena (docs): I'll take the RN copy. Quick ask: add a short known-issue blurb about the KV spike and a pointer to the troubleshooting runbook.

maria (product): Added owners: pin/james, canary/kai, rollback/miguel, docs/lena. I'll update the RN with the known-issue note.

james (relops): OK to pin to SHA `a7f9c3b` for the release. Scheduling deploy job now. @deploy-bot can you queue the canary at 10% for 30m in the 02:00 window?

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued by james. Plan: canary 10% (00:30), ramp to 50% (00:30) then 100% if green. Rollback hook attached.

kai (backend): I'll set up extra tracing for the KV path during canary. Also adding an eval prompt set for edge sequences to catch regressions.

miguel (eng-sre): Runbook check: rollback steps are in /runbooks/runtime-rollbacks.md — updated with the model pin and SHA. I added the exact kubectl commands and the alert thresholds.

lena (docs): RN draft updated in the doc. Short blurb added: "Intermittent KV cache latency spike observed under long sequences in staging; mitigations are in place."

james (relops): One more: if canary sees a new error type (5xx from runtime) at >0.5%, escalate to oncall and hold rollout. Who is oncall that window?

miguel (eng-sre): Oncall Rota shows @olivia is oncall that night. I'll ping her 30m prior and post the canary dashboards.

maria (product): Thanks — sounds good. Final ask: docs + relops please approve RN by EOD UTC today so we can post the internal announcement and pin the release. :thumbsup:

james (relops): Approved from relops side.

lena (docs): Approved copy LGTM.

miguel (eng-sre): Approved for rollback/runbook.

maria (product): Awesome — I'll publish the internal announcement once deploy-bot marks the job scheduled. :party:

deploy-bot: Job scheduled: prod-deploy-v2.3.0 | window 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z - 2026-03-22T04:00:00Z | canary 10% (30m) -> 50% (30m) -> 100% | rollback threshold: err_rate>1% OR p95>40% increase | pinned SHA: a7f9c3b

maria (product): Internal announcement posted to #general and #eng-releases. Link: https://docs.internal/release-notes/v2.3.0-internal
